item.title: Jones vs. Aspinall set for UFC 320 main event
item.dc:creator: Brett Okamoto
item.description: The heavyweight title fight between Jon Jones and Tom Aspinall is official for UFC 320, sources told ESPN.

item.title: Report: Alex Pereira dealing with hand injury ahead of planned return
item.dc:creator: Marc Raimondi
item.description: Alex Pereira is reportedly dealing with a hand injury and could be forced out of his planned bout, sources say.
